raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS problem_loan_rate
FROM main."loan" l
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996
    AND l.date <= DATE '1996-06-30'
```
